title: Running Sum Appears Underconstrained for Certain Configurations #820
publisher: zcash/halo2 (GitHub issue; report by Veridise researchers)

search_queries: site:zcash.github.io/halo2 testing circuit mock prover witness constraints adversarial witness

source_authority: Primary project issue in the Halo2 repository. The reported analysis and suggested test come from external researchers; the issue also includes a Halo2 contributor response.
precise_locator: Issue description, lines 160-165; maintainer response, lines 172-182.
falsifiable_source_claims: The issue reports Picus found RunningSum underconstrained for WORD_NUM_BITS=255, NUM_WINDOWS=85, WINDOW_NUM_BITS=3, strict=true.
The issue attributes two base-8 decompositions to a representable range [0, 2^255) that exceeds the Pallas field modulus.
The issue proposes a test showing two representations of zero, and a Halo2 contributor later describes the non-unique decomposition as intentional but insufficiently documented.
